title: Soundness of work-action decoding
statement: If the work-action reader succeeds on a bit string $x$, returning an optional work-tape write $w$, a head movement $m\in\{-1,0,1\}$, and suffix $r$, then $x$ is the encoding of $w$ followed by the encoding of $m$, followed by $r$.
hypotheses_covered: The work-action reader returns (w,m) and suffix r on input x
